Name: Immersive Bath - Loofahs
Author: Ekibo3
Description:
This mod adds a retexture for the bath sponge from [b]ZeroXPatch's[/b] [i][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41604]Immersive Bath[/url]﻿[/i], replacing it with colourful loofahs. It includes four colour options: pink, blue, green and purple.

[size=4]Requirements
[/size]• [b]SMAPI[/b]
• [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
• [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41604]Immersive Bath

[/url]﻿[size=4]Installation
[/size]Install [b]Immersive Bath[/b].
Download and extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[size=4]Configuration
[/size]Either use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿ or, open the config.json after running the game once with the mod installed and set your preferred colour.

[size=4]Compatibility
[/size]This mod only replaces the bath sponge texture used by Immersive Bath and should be compatible with most other mods.

[size=4]Credits
[/size]•[b] ZeroXPatch[/b] – creator of Immersive Bath
